meta.name: google-agents-cli-workflow
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "develop an agent", "build an agent using ADK", "run the agent locally", "debug agent code", "test an agent", "deploy an agent", "publish an agent", "monitor an agent", or needs the ADK (Agent Development Kit) development lifecycle and coding guidelines. Entrypoint for building ADK agents. Always active — provides the full workflow (scaffold, build, evaluate, deploy, publish, observe), code preservation rules, model selection guidance, and troubleshooting steps for ADK or any agent development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从零搭建 AI 智能体,并走完本地调试、测试到上线的全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正打算用 ADK 做一个 AI 智能体,却不确定开发流程怎么走。
copy.tagline_en: Turn an agent idea into a scaffolded, tested, deployable AI agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building your first AI agent with ADK and need the full workflow.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 ADK 开发流程带你走一遍：先做设计对话、写出 .agents-cli-spec.md，再脚手架建项目、写代码、跑评估、部署、发布、监控，并遵守代码保留规则。
howto.when: 当你提到「用 ADK 构建 agent」、「本地运行/调试 agent」等需求，或要做 ADK 开发生命周期中的任一步骤时触发；该技能常驻。

say.text: 用 ADK 建一个 agent，先跟我确认设计再脚手架
say.note: 先进入设计对话，产出 spec 后才动手

say.text: 帮我给现有代码加上 agents-cli 项目结构
say.note: 执行 scaffold enhance，补上目录与配置

say.text: 跑一下 agents-cli eval，看看 agent 行为评分
say.note: 按数据集生成并打分，再一起看结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude walks you through the ADK agent lifecycle: a design dialogue and .agents-cli-spec.md first, then scaffold, code, evaluate, deploy, publish and observe, following code-preservation rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build an agent with ADK, run or debug an agent locally, deploy, publish or monitor one, or need any step of the ADK development lifecycle. Always active.

say_en.text: Build an ADK agent; confirm the design with me before scaffolding.
say_en.note: Runs the design dialogue, writes the spec, then scaffolds

say_en.text: Add the agents-cli structure to my existing code.
say_en.note: Runs scaffold enhance to add project layout and config

say_en.text: Run agents-cli eval and review the agent scores.
say_en.note: Generates and grades cases, then reviews results with you
